(63)༄/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len bsdus don gyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (63)༄// byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len bsdus don gyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/// /

(64)༄༅// phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba bskong ba'i gsung*// ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs// shākya'i gtso bo de la mgos phyag 'tshal// zla med ston pa de yi sras kyi mchog /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kun gyi khur bsnams nas// grangs med zhing du sprul pas rnam rol ba// mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu dpag par dka' ba rgyal ba'i yum// ji bzhin dgongs pa 'grel mdzad 'dzam gling rgyan// klu sgrub thogs med ces ni sa gsum na// yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la bdag phyag 'tshal// shing rta chen po gnyis las legs brgyud pa'i// zab mo'i lta ba rgya chen spyod ba'i lam// ma nor yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad bsdus pa'i// gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin mar me mdzad la 'dud// rab 'byams gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig /skal bzang thar bar bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog /brtse bas spyod pa'i thabs mkhas mdzad pa yis// gsal mdzad bshes gnyen rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ ༈ /'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan// snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro la lhang nge ba// klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du// legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pa ni// skye rgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na// gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal bo ste// (65)gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'dus pa'i phyir// dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho 'ang yin// bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang*// gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang*// nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang bsrung*// de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo ni// skal ldan du mas bsten pa'i gdams pa mchog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yis// yid rab mi 'phrog dpyad ldan su zhig yod/ ༈ /gsung rab kun gyi snying po bsdu bsdu ba// tshul 'di thun re ston dang nyan pas kyang*// dam chos 'chad dang thos pa'i phan yon tshogs// rlabs chen sdud par nges pas de don bsam/

༈ /de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i// rten 'brel legs par 'grigs pa'i rtsa ba ni// lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yis// bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten par// mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byed// rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar bgyis// thar 'dod khyod kyang de bzhin bskyang 'tshal lo/ ༈ /dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin// rnyed dka' 'jig sla (66)nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra// tshul 'di bsams nas 'jig rten bya ba kun// sbun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur nas// nyin mtshan kun tu snying bo len pa dgos// rnal 'byor ngas kyang*/ thar 'dod khyed kyang*/ tshig rkang 'di gnyis phyin chad kun la'ang 'gre/ ༈ /shi nas ngan 'gror mi skye'i gding med cing*// de yi 'jigs skyob dkon mchog gsum du nges// de phyir skyabs 'gro shin tu brtan pa dang*// de yi bslab bya nyams pa med par bya// de yang dkar nag las 'bras legs bsam nas// blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub la rag las so// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= /lam mchog /sgrub la mtshan nyid tshang ba'i rten// ma rnyed bar dus tshod mi 'ong bas// de yi ma tshang med pa'i rgyud la bslab// sgo gsum sdig ltung dri ma mas sbags pa 'di// lhag par las sgrib sbyong ba gnad che bas// rgyun du stobs bzhi tshang ba brten pa gces// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= ༈ /sdug bden nyes dmigs bsam la ma 'bad na// thar pa don gnyer ji bzhin mi skye zhing*// kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim ma bsam na// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod tshul mi shes pas// srid las nges 'byung skyo shas brten pa dang*// 'khor bar gang gis bcings pa shes pa gces// rnal 'byor// thar 'dod/ ༈ sems bskyed theg mchog lam gyi gzhung shing ste// rlabs chen spyod pa rnams kyi gzhi dang rten// tshogs gnyis kun la gser 'gyur rtsi lta bu// rab 'byams dge tshogs sdud pa'i bsod nams gter// de ltar shes nas rgyal sras dbang bo rnams// rin chen sems mchog thugs dam mthil du 'dzin// rnal 'byor// thar 'dod// sbyin pa 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin nor// ser sna'i mdud pa gcod pa'i mtshon cha mchog

/ma zhum snying stobs bskyed pa'i rgyal sras (67)spyod// snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs bcur sgrogs pa'i gzhi// de ltar shes nas lus dang longs spyod dge// yongs su gtong ba'i lam bzang mkhas pas bsten// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= /tshul khrims nyes spyod dri ma 'khyud pa'i chu// nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba'i zla ba'i 'od// skyes dgu'i dbus na lhun po lta bur brjid// stobs kyis bsdigs pa med par 'gro kun 'dud// de ltar shes nas yang dag blangs pa'i khrims// dam pa rnams kyis mig bzhin bsrung bar mdzod// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= /bzod pa stobs ldan rnams la rgyan gyi mchog /nyon mongs gsang ba'i dka' thub kun gyi phul// zhe sdang lag 'gro'i dgra la nam mkha' lding*// tshig rtsub mtshon la sra ba'i go cha yin// de ltar shes nas bzod mchog go cha la// rnam pa sna tshogs tshul gyis bsgoms par mdzad// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= /mi ldog brtan pa'i brtson 'grus go bgos na// lung rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel// spyod lam thams cad don dang ldan par 'gyur// gang brtsams las kyi mtha' rnams yid bzhin 'grub// de ltar shes nas le lo kun sel ba'i// rlabs chen brtson 'grus rgyal sras rnams kyis brtsams// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= /bsam gtan sems la dbang sgyur rgyal bo ste// bzhag na g.yo med ri yi dbang bo bzhin// btang na dge ba'i dmigs pa kun la 'jug /lus sems las su rung ba'i bde chen 'dren// de ltar shes nas rnal 'byor dbang bo rnams// rnam g.yeng dgra 'joms ting 'dzin rgyun tu bsten// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= /shes rab zab mo'i de nyid blta ba'i mig /srid pa'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin pa'i lam// gsung rab kun las bsngags pa'i yon tan gter// gti mug mun sel sgron me'i mchog tu (68)grags// de ltar shes nas thar 'dod mkhas pa yis// lam de 'bad pa du mas bskyed par mdzad// rnal 'byor=

/thar 'dod= /rtse gcig bsam gtan tsam las 'khor ba yi// rtsa ba gcod pa'i nus pa ma mthong zhing*// zhi gnas lam dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis// ji tsam dpyad kyang nyon mongs mi ldog pas// yin lugs phug thag chod pa'i shes rab de// g.yo med zhi gnas rta la bskyon nas ni// mtha' bral dbu ma'i rig pa'i mtshon rnon gyis// mthar 'dzin dmigs gtad thams cad 'jig byed pa'i// tshul bzhin dpyod pa'i yangs pa'i shes rab kyis// de nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros rgyas par mdzad// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= /rtse gcig bsgoms pas ting 'dzin 'grub pa ni// smos par ci 'tshal tshul bzhin dpyod pa yi// so sor rtog pa yis kyang yin lugs la// g.yo med shin tu brtan par gnas pa yi// ting 'dzin bskyed par mthong nas zhi lhag gnyis// zung 'brel sgrub la brtson rnams ya mtshan no// rnal 'byor// thar 'dod// mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid dang*// rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i stong ba gnyis// bsgoms nas thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yis// rgyal sras spyod pa'i pha rol 'gro ba bsngags// de ltar rtogs nas phyogs re'i lam gyis ni// tshim pa med pa skal bzang rnams kyi lugs// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= ༈ /de ltar rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg chen gyi// lam mchog gnyis kar dgos pa'i thun mong lam// ji bzhin dpyad nas mkhas pa'i ded dpon gyi// mgon la brten nas rgyud sde rgya mtsho cher// zhugs nas yongs rdzogs man ngag brten pa des// dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par byas// rnal 'byor= /thar 'dod= ༈ /rang gi yid la goms par bya phyir dang*// skal bzang gzhan la'ang (69)phan par bya ba'i phyir// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i yongs su rdzogs pa'i lam// go sla'i ngag gis bshad pa'i dge ba des// 'gro ba kun kyang rnam dag lam bzang dang*// 'bral med gyur cig ces ni smon lam 'debs// rnal 'byor ngas kyang smon lam de ltar btab// thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin 'debs 'tshal lo// zhes byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len gyi rnam bzhag mdor bsdus te brjod pa rang byas pa 'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong spong ba pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis// 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du sbyar ba'o/// /

༈ /'di nyid bsher sgom gyi tshul du ngag 'don bgyid pa'i tshe// rnal 'byor ngas kyang sogs tshig rkang gnyis la// rje btsun bla mas nyams len de ltar mdzad// thar 'dod bdag kyang de bzhin bskyang 'tshal lo// zhes bsgyur nas brjod pa gsung rgyun las 'byung ngo*// maṅga laṃ/// // /(70)
